backlog.title: Export to Word (.docx)
backlog.description: Export story or chapter to Microsoft Word format for editing and print preparation

backlog.title: Export to PDF
backlog.description: Generate PDF documents from stories for sharing and archival

backlog.title: Cloud backup integration
backlog.description: Automatic backup to cloud storage (S3, Google Drive, etc.) for disaster recovery

backlog.title: Split-pane editor
backlog.description: Side-by-side view of story content and feedback/metadata. CodeMirror 6 source pane + marked.js preview pane with resizable splitter.

backlog.title: Keyboard shortcuts
backlog.description: Common keyboard shortcuts for navigation and editing (Cmd+S save, Cmd+Z undo, etc.). See SPEC-004 in REQUIREMENTS.md for full table.

backlog.title: Version history / Timeline view
backlog.description: Track changes over time, view diff between versions, restore previous versions

backlog.title: Drag-drop story reordering
backlog.description: Reorganize story order within arcs by dragging in dashboard

backlog.title: Keyboard shortcut help modal
backlog.description: Show available keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+? or ? key). Bundled with S1.3.

backlog.title: Random story button
backlog.description: Quick button to jump to a random story for inspiration or review

backlog.title: Recent edits on dashboard
backlog.description: Show recently edited stories on the main dashboard

backlog.title: Reading time estimate
backlog.description: Display estimated reading time for each story

backlog.title: Medium integration
backlog.description: One-click publish directly to Medium from dashboard

backlog.title: AI-assisted editing
backlog.description: Use Claude API for tone suggestions, expansion recommendations, copy editing

backlog.title: Collaborative editing with real-time sync
backlog.description: Real-time updates when Carina makes changes (websocket-based)

backlog.title: Dark/Light theme toggle
backlog.description: Theme selector for user preference

backlog.title: Markdown formatting toolbar
backlog.description: Bold, italic, headings, lists, links, blockquotes — buttons that hook into CodeMirror commands.

backlog.title: Find and replace
backlog.description: In-doc Cmd+F via @codemirror/search; cross-story Cmd+Shift+F via new GET /api/search endpoint.

backlog.title: Editor extraction (web/editor.js)
backlog.description: Move editor JS out of web/index.html (currently 3224 lines) into web/editor.js. Goal: drop index.html below 2500 lines.

backlog.title: Full manuscript compile
backlog.description: Server-side compiler orders stories by arc → date_event → filename. Foundation for Word and PDF exports. POST /api/compile.

backlog.title: Export templates
backlog.description: Memoir (book) and Blog (Medium-ready) starter templates. Pluggable via templates/export/ directory. Trim candidate if Sprint 2 runs long.

backlog.title: Export UI menu
backlog.description: Replace 'Export for Medium' button with Export menu (Word/PDF/Markdown/Medium) and scope picker (Story/Arc/Manuscript). Spinner for long compiles.
